name: How long does an exterior water intrusion repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does an exterior water intrusion repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an exterior water intrusion repair depends on the extent of the damage and the complexity of the fix. Simple repairs, such as re-caulking around a window or minor flashing repair, might be completed within a day. More complex issues involving structural repairs, large-scale re-siding, or foundation waterproofing can take several days to a few weeks. We provide a projected timeline with our repair estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair times vary from a single day for minor issues to several weeks for complex structural or foundation repairs. We provide a projected timeline after assessment.
